checks.description: ci.yml ya no tiene el job runner-info: solo imprimía datos del runner y costaba un job por run
El job changes de ci.yml clona el historial completo sin blobs (filter: blob:none)
scripts/job-timings.sh calcula cola, duración y minutos facturables redondeados por job, y el reloj del run
checks.assert: stdout~^Reloj del run: 95 s · minutos facturables: 3 \| api / Tests \| 5 \| 90 \| 2 \| \| web \| 0 \| 0 \| 0 \| \| \*\*Total\*\* \| 8 \| 130 \| 3 \| $

checks.description: scripts/ci-trend.sh da runs, tasa de éxito, p50 y p95, y avisa con ::warning si el p95 pasa de BUDGET
checks.cmd: f=$(jq -nc 'range(20) as $i | {conclusion: (if $i < 17 then "success" else "failure" end), run_started_at: "2026-11-14T10:00:00Z", updated_at: (1794650400 + ($i + 1) * 30 | todate)}'); a=$(printf '%s' "$f" | BUDGET=900 scripts/ci-trend.sh 2>&1 | tail -1); w=$(printf '%s' "$f" | BUDGET=500 scripts/ci-trend.sh 2>&1 >/dev/null); echo "$a $w"

checks.description: ci-metrics.yml corre al terminar ci en main, cada semana por cron y a mano
checks.cmd: yq '(.on | keys | sort | join(",")) + " from=" + (.on.workflow_run.workflows | join(",")) + " types=" + (.on.workflow_run.types | join(",")) + " branches=" + (.on.workflow_run.branches | join(","))' .github/workflows/ci-metrics.yml

checks.description: ci-metrics.yml tiene permissions vacío en la raíz y sus jobs solo leen Actions y el código, con timeout
checks.cmd: yq '"root=" + (.permissions | length | tostring) + " " + ([.jobs | to_entries[] | .key + ":" + (.value.permissions | to_entries | map(.key + "=" + .value) | sort | join("+")) + ":" + (.value | has("timeout-minutes") | tostring)] | join(" "))' .github/workflows/ci-metrics.yml

checks.description: El job run vuelca los jobs del run medido en scripts/job-timings.sh, y el job trend los runs de ci en main en scripts/ci-trend.sh con el presupuesto de vars.CI_P95_BUDGET_SECONDS; los dos al resumen
checks.cmd: yq '.jobs.run.steps[-1].run as $r | .jobs.trend.steps[-1] as $t | "run=" + ([($r | test("runs/\$RUN_ID/jobs")), ($r | test("job-timings\.sh")), ($r | test("GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"))] | all | tostring) + " trend=" + ([($t.run | test("workflows/ci\.yml/runs")), ($t.run | test("branch=main")), ($t.run | test("ci-trend\.sh")), ($t.run | test("GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"))] | all | tostring) + " budget=" + ($t.env.BUDGET // "")' .github/workflows/ci-metrics.yml

checks.description: scripts/prune-caches.sh borra solo las cachés de PR cerrados y de ramas que ya no existen, y con DRY_RUN=true no borra nada
checks.cmd:
s="$PWD/scripts/prune-caches.sh"; t=$(mktemp -d); printf '%s
' '#!/usr/bin/env bash' 'case "$1 $2" in' '"api repos/{owner}/{repo}/branches?per_page=100") printf "main
feat/x
" ;;' '"pr list") echo 7 ;;' '"cache list") printf "1 refs/heads/main
2 refs/pull/7/merge
3 refs/pull/8/merge
4 refs/heads/gh-readonly-queue/main/pr-8-abc
5 refs/heads/feat/x
6 refs/tags/v1.0.0
" ;;' '"cache delete") echo "$3" >> "${0%/gh}/deleted" ;;' 'esac' > "$t/gh"; chmod +x "$t/gh"; PATH="$t:$PATH" DRY_RUN=true "$s" >/dev/null && d=$(cat "$t/deleted" 2>/dev/null | tr '
' ','); PATH="$t:$PATH" "$s" >/dev/null && r=$(tr '
' ',' < "$t/deleted"); rm -rf "$t"; echo "dry=$d real=$r"

checks.description: cleanup.yml corre cada día y a mano (con dry-run por defecto), y solo su job escribe en Actions
checks.cmd: yq '(.on | keys | sort | join(",")) + " dry=" + (.on.workflow_dispatch.inputs."dry-run".default | tostring) + " root=" + (.permissions | length | tostring) + " jobs=" + ([.jobs[] | (.permissions.actions // "none") + ":" + (has("timeout-minutes") | tostring)] | join(",")) + " env=" + ([.jobs[].steps[] | select(.run // "" | test("prune-caches\.sh")) | .env.DRY_RUN] | join(""))' .github/workflows/cleanup.yml
checks.assert: stdout~^schedule,workflow_dispatch dry=true root=0 jobs=write:true env=\$\{\{ inputs\.dry-run \}\}$

checks.description: Todos los workflows pasan actionlint y zizmor sin hallazgos
La variable de repositorio CI_P95_BUDGET_SECONDS fija el presupuesto de p95 del CI en segundos
ci-metrics terminó en success tras el ci del último commit de main
checks.cmd: git fetch -q origin main && gh run list --workflow ci-metrics.yml --event workflow_run --commit "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" --json conclusion --jq '[.[].conclusion] | first'

checks.description: La tendencia de ci-metrics corrió a mano en success sobre el último commit de main
checks.cmd: git fetch -q origin main && gh run list --workflow ci-metrics.yml --event workflow_dispatch --commit "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" --json conclusion --jq '[.[].conclusion] | first'

checks.description: El repo guarda artefactos y logs 14 días
cleanup terminó en success sobre el último commit de main
checks.cmd: git fetch -q origin main && gh run list --workflow cleanup.yml --commit "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" --json conclusion --jq '[.[].conclusion] | first'
